H01.description: Adds a changelog entry for the --jobs GNU parallel abort fix.

H02.description: Because `!` negates only the `type -p` check, the abort runs only when parallel is missing and `parallel --version` also succeeds, which can never both happen, so --jobs without GNU parallel never aborts here and fails later instead.
